Solstice Broadband -- Weekly Ops Triage Notes
Attendees: J. Vance (Ops Lead), T. Okafor (Support Lead), R. Adeyemi (Billing Lead)
Date: Oct 6, 2026

Agenda: Review escalated case backlog before Friday's SLA report. Five open cases carried over from last week's queue, summarized below with proposed ownership for each.

Case #1 -- Account 55521: Customer's third repair visit for the same modem issue in two months. Tech notes say the previous two visits 'fixed' the symptom for about a week before it recurred, and both visiting technicians used different equipment, which rules out a simple bad-unit swap as the answer. Decision: needs root-cause engineering review, not another routine repair visit. Assign to Network Engineering, not Field Dispatch.

Case #2 -- Account 55890: Customer emailed twice this week asking why their autopay charged $12 more than the quoted promo rate, and was starting to sound annoyed in the second email about the lack of a reply. R. Adeyemi confirmed the promo code was applied one billing cycle late by mistake on our end, not anything the customer did wrong. Decision: Billing to issue a one-cycle credit and confirm the promo is now active, with a brief apology for the slow initial response.

Case #3 -- Account 56004: Customer called in Tuesday saying they're 'probably going to switch to CedarLink once my contract's up in December' but for now just wants to know if their current plan supports mesh WiFi extenders, since their house has dead zones upstairs. T. Okafor notes this reads like a product/compatibility question dressed up with some venting about the competitor -- no cancellation has actually been requested and the contract isn't up for two more months anyway. Decision: treat as a technical compatibility question for now; flag the account for a retention touchpoint only if they call back closer to December.

Case #4 -- Account 56102: Formal letter received demanding immediate account deletion and citing a data-protection statute; customer says the account was closed in June. R. Adeyemi flagged this as outside Billing's remit and forwarded it to the privacy team.

Case #5 -- Account 56210: Customer requested a copy of their last 12 months of invoices for a small business tax filing, nothing in dispute, just needs the documents. R. Adeyemi: routine document request. Decision: Billing to send the invoice history within 2 business days, no further discussion needed and no escalation of any kind.

Action items: T. Okafor to reassign Case #1 to Engineering by EOD Friday. R. Adeyemi to close out Case #2 credit today and send Case #5's invoice history by Thursday.
